test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The heart that is __full of grieve__ is heavy.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Grief"** is the correct **noun** form to use in this context, meaning **deep sorrow.**
 
• **Format: *Full of + noun.***
 
• **Grieve: **is a verb that means to feel great sadness.
 
• The phrase **"full of grief"** fits grammatically and conveys the intended meaning accurately.

**Therefore, the correct answer is- "full of grief."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Option 1 "filled with grieve" **incorrectly uses "grieve," a verb, instead of the noun form "grief."
 
• **Option 3 "filling with grief"** suggests an ongoing action which doesn’t fit the context as well as a state being described.
 
• **Option 4 "full of grieving" **awkwardly uses "grieving," the gerund form of the verb, rather than the more concise noun "grief."
